record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: The three units in appliesTo declare RAZOR_LEAF in this production reference. The strategy is shared; differences are star count and stats; all three declare no passive in the catalog.
record.summary: Deals SPECIAL damage (raw 20/40/80/160 by caster stars, 2-star Nuzleaf 40, 1-star Seedot 20, 3-star Shiftry 80) to every unit of another team on the ray of cells that starts next to the caster and runs in one of the 8 board directions chosen by the sign of the offset to the cast target, to the board edge. The ray is not stopped by units, so enemies behind the target are hit too, and the ray is not the straight line to the target: a target at a non-axis, non-diagonal offset is treated as lying on the nearest-by-sign diagonal. If the ray holds no enemy, the cast target alone is damaged. The RIGHT ray stops at x = 5 (loop bound board.rows) on the 8-column board. The cast can crit by default (canCritByDefault = true). No status effect, no movement.

targeting.who: every unit of another team on the cells of the ray from the caster toward the cast target; fallback: the cast target
targeting.note: board.orientation(caster, target) uses only the signs of dx and dy, so any target not on the same row or column is treated as lying on a diagonal even if it is not. The callback's team filter is not isTargettableBy, so untargettable enemies on the ray are included by the strategy (whether handleSpecialDamage then affects them was not traced). If no enemy was found on the ray, effectInOrientation calls the callback once on the target's own cell, so the target is damaged; if some other enemy was found but the target was off the ray, the target is not hit.

geometry.shape: ray in one of 8 directions from the cell next to the caster to the board edge (no width, no falloff); UP walks y upward, RIGHT walks x upward but with the bound x < board.rows (6) so columns 6 and 7 are never visited, the other directions use the board bounds

effects.target: each unit of another team on the ray (visited cells, each at most once as units occupy one cell); else the cast target
effects.scaling: AP: damage x (1 + AP/100) (apBoost defaults to true); the cast's crit flag multiplies by critPower (reduced by the target's crit reduction) when the cast rolled a crit; canCritByDefault is true so the crit is rolled with chance critChance/100 for every cast; no falloff along the ray
effects.resolution: requested = the raw amount; applied = after AP/crit, the target's SPE_DEF division and later untraced modifiers (core-mechanics section A: division by 1 + 0.05 x SPE_DEF, ceil, minimum 1); protect / skydiving / magicBounce targets take none. The strategy does not read takenDamage.

starBehavior.note: indexed by the casting entity's stars; the 4-star value (160, also the fallback) is not reachable by the bare factory star counts. maxPP and range are in appliesTo.

record.positionalConditions: Which units are hit depends on the caster's and target's coordinates only through the sign of dx and dy: same row or column gives a straight ray, any other offset gives a diagonal ray from the caster that may miss the target. RIGHT-facing rays never reach columns 6 and 7 on the 8 x 6 board (loop bound board.rows). Allies on the ray are skipped by the team filter.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state or modes. Each cast spends maxPP of PP and recomputes the ray.
record.rawVsResolved: Declared raw: 20/40/80 (1/2/3 stars) per unit hit. Damage dealt per unit = raw x (1 + AP/100) [x crit factor], then the target's SPE_DEF division (ceil, at least 1) and untraced modifiers.
dependsOnUnverifiedGenericCombat: Final damage after handleSpecialDamage's later modifiers (SPE_DEF division, shields, items, resurrection, field multipliers); only the shared references in core-mechanics section A were consulted
When the cast fires in a real fight (PP gain, targeting, silence); only the pp >= maxPP && canCast gate was read
Crit chance value (critChance) and critPower; only the roll gate was located
unresolved: Whether an untargettable enemy on the ray is damaged: the callback filter is team only and handleSpecialDamage was not traced for it

The effectInOrientation case where the caster is already on a board edge in the chosen direction (empty ray) falls through to the target-cell fallback; real board frequency not examined
